lesson: Review round 2 (post re-vendor, all three lenses): ONE P1 finding, the same in every lens — the Postgres integration test title and its fixture identifiers still say "legacy" for the non-human put, get, list and revoke (apps/core/test/integration/permission-decision-memory.postgres.integration.test.ts:36 and :80-94). Those methods are live access paths, and the contract's NO LEFTOVERS rule forbids "legacy" naming anywhere in the diff. The wording came from the contract's own leaf title; contract v12 renames the leaf to "non-human put, get, list and revoke" / "unfiltered non-human list". Do exactly this and nothing else: (1) rename that it(...) title to the v12 leaf title verbatim; (2) rename the fixture strings exact:legacy-guard, person-legacy-guard (both), effect-human-legacy-guard to exact:non-human-guard, person-non-human-guard, effect-human-non-human-guard; (3) grep the whole diff against origin/main for the word legacy (case-insensitive) and remove any other occurrence you introduced — do NOT touch pre-existing occurrences outside this task's files. Run the renamed leaf through the Postgres config (source the env file the brief names) and prettier on the file. No product-code change is expected.
